reconstruction.summary: Python C-API wrapper that reads a line from a Pinot binary stream. Takes one argument (a stream/handle), reads a line, and returns a tuple (success_flag: int, line_data: bytes).
reconstruction.behavioral_notes: 1) Takes a single Python object argument (stream handle) via PyArg_ParseTuple format "O". 2) Converts handle to stream pointer. 3) Reads a line from the binary stream. 4) Returns a 2-element tuple: (int success_flag, bytes line_data). 5) The int success flag is a bool (0/1) built via PyLong_FromLong using format char at S_0010fbf4. 6) No Python call site found in __init__.py — unknown callers.
side_effects: Reads from binary stream (advances stream position)
